Subject: Aligning calendars: private-hosted architecture review & ops deep dive

Hi Ashley —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap so we have the same frame before the next call:
- Goal: walk CareBridge through a Private (VPC) hosting architecture that meets your data residency and audit requirements, plus a short ops/runbook review so your SREs are comfortable with failover and upgrade behavior.
- Key constraints you mentioned: regional (US-east), strict log retention & isolated KMS, and a requirement to support both batch and low-latency inference at peak hours.
- Internal stakeholders to include: your cloud/security lead (Ben), and our SE + infra lead for the deep dive.

Next step: schedule a 75-minute architecture + ops deep-dive (we typically do 45m architecture + 30m ops/questions). Below are suggested slots (all US/Pacific):
- Thurs 16 Feb, 09:30–10:45
- Fri 17 Feb, 13:00–14:15
- Mon 20 Feb, 10:00–11:15

If none of those work, please send 2–3 times that suit Ben and any additional folks. I’ve attached a one-page prep workbook and a stub network diagram to make the call more efficient. Also linking a quick checklist and a Calendly if you want to pick a slot directly: https://calendly.com/redwood/neha-priv-ops-deep-dive

Attachments: redwood-priv-vpc-prep.xlsx (worksheet), network-diagram-stub.png (PNG)

Thanks — I’ll hold these slots tentative until I hear back.

—
